scripts.title: Fast Train
scripts.features: Allows you to train really (and I mean REALLY) fast, at a configurable rate.
scripts.script:
--- {settings} ---
local TrainPriority = 0 -- time to wait when binding stuff with runservice (priority = time to wait basically)
local EvenFasterTraining = false
--------------------------------------------------------------

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local CurrentWorld = Player["worlds"].currentworld

local Benchpress = nil
local CurrentMap = nil

for num, item in workspace.maps:GetChildren() do
	if item.Name:gsub("%D", "") == CurrentWorld.Value:gsub("%D", "") then
		CurrentMap = item
		Benchpress = CurrentMap.training.benchpress
	end
end

game.RunService:BindToRenderStep("FastTrain", TrainPriority, function()

local omginstance1 = Benchpress
local omgboolean2 = true

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").remotes.train:FireServer(omginstance1, omgboolean2)

local omginstance1 = Benchpress
local omgboolean2 = EvenFasterTraining

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").remotes.train:FireServer(omginstance1, omgboolean2)
end)
